# Architecture

## Page map

- **Home** (`Pages/Home`) — The list, grouped by status, with a way to add a book
- **Book** (`Pages/Book`) — One book: change its status or remove it

## Data model

### Book

One book on the list

Fields:
- title
- author
- status

## Backend contracts

none — kept on the device
